subject: Human Evolution
title: The Hobbit of Flores
description: A quick, practical guide to The Hobbit of Flores.

hook.text: In 2003, researchers on the Indonesian island of Flores found a 1-metre-tall adult human skeleton.

buildup.text: Homo floresiensis had a brain the size of a chimpanzee's but made tools and hunted pygmy elephants.

discovery.text: They survived until just 50,000 years ago—meaning they overlapped with modern humans in the region.

twist.text: Local legends speak of small forest people called Ebu Gogo. Coincidence or cultural memory?

climax.text: Flores proved that human evolution produced far stranger experiments than anyone had imagined.

punchline.text: A real 'hobbit' walked the Earth recently.

quiz.question: What was unusual about Homo floresiensis?
options: They were only about 1 metre tall
